validation_summary.props_budget_note: Props auto uses landmark fallback (15000/3000/500), which is separate from their explicit node/terrain-kit/prefab validators and stricter local caps. These stricter checks are reported separately for all six props.
validation_summary.tone_coverage_note: Only existing measured LODs are summarized. Town floor 0.26, present Team floor 0.30; samples must be nonempty. Ground has no assigned floor. No unmeasured LOD1 or per-root tone pass is inferred.

packed_loader.loader: Actual GLTFLoader with MeshoptDecoder and current parseKit
packed_loader.texture_limit: Node image bitmap mock preserves actual dimensions; native browser screenshots separately verify texture rendering
